mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_content_unit WHERE document_id IN (SELECT d.id FROM t_document d JOIN t_source_version v ON v.id=d.source_version_id JOIN t_source s ON s.id=v.source_id WHERE s.knowledge_base_id=#{kb})
mapper.select: SELECT knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,strategy, chunk_size chunkSize,chunk_overlap chunkOverlap,min_chunk_size minChunkSize,measure, keep_structure keepStructure,respect_sentence respectSentence,parent_child parentChild, updated_by updatedBy,updated_time updatedTime FROM t_chunk_policy WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_chunk_policy(knowledge_base_id,strategy,chunk_size,chunk_overlap, min_chunk_size,measure,keep_structure,respect_sentence,parent_child,updated_by) VALUES(#{kb},#{strategy},#{chunkSize},#{chunkOverlap},#{minChunkSize},#{measure}, #{keepStructure},#{respectSentence},#{parentChild},#{updatedBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE strategy=VALUES(strategy),chunk_size=VALUES(chunk_size), chunk_overlap=VALUES(chunk_overlap),min_chunk_size=VALUES(min_chunk_size),measure=VALUES(measure), keep_structure=VALUES(keep_structure),respect_sentence=VALUES(respect_sentence), parent_child=VALUES(parent_child),updated_by=VALUES(updated_by),updated_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT c.id,c.document_id documentId, c.unit_code unitCode,c.parent_id parentId,c.heading_path headingPath, c.chunk_type chunkType,c.page_no pageNo,c.page_end pageEnd,c.char_start charStart, c.char_end charEnd,c.token_count tokenCount,c.content,c.content_hash contentHash, c.status,c.revision, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_content_unit x WHERE x.document_id=c.document_id AND x.id<=c.id) seq, doc.title documentTitle,doc.document_code documentCode, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_evidence e WHERE e.content_unit_id=c.id) evidenceCount FROM t_content_unit c LEFT JOIN t_document doc ON doc.id=c.document_id WHERE c.unit_code=#{code} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_source_version sv JOIN t_source s ON s.id=sv.source_id WHERE sv.id=doc.source_version_id AND s.knowledge_base_id=#{kb})

SELECT e.evidence_code evidenceCode, e.quote_text quoteText,e.location_json locationJson,e.authority_score authorityScore, e.freshness_score freshnessScore,e.created_time createdTime, s.name sourceName,s.source_code sourceCode, doc.title documentTitle,doc.document_code documentCode FROM t_evidence e JOIN t_content_unit c ON c.id=e.content_unit_id LEFT JOIN t_source s ON s.id=e.source_id LEFT JOIN t_document doc ON doc.id=c.document_id WHERE c.unit_code=#{code} AND e.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} ORDER BY e.id

(SELECT unit_code unitCode,'PREV' pos, heading_path headingPath,page_no pageNo,chunk_type chunkType,LEFT(content,180) excerpt FROM t_content_unit WHERE document_id=#{documentId} AND id<#{id} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL (SELECT unit_code unitCode,'NEXT' pos, heading_path headingPath,page_no pageNo,chunk_type chunkType,LEFT(content,180) excerpt FROM t_content_unit WHERE document_id=#{documentId} AND id>#{id} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1)
